debt_rule: eliminating an unresolved semantic bit without a checked witness-selection rule moves one unit from live bits to debt, so it claims zero progress
discharge_rule: debt may be removed only by a polynomial-size independently checked witness-selection/Skolem rule or a certified terminal argument that the choice is irrelevant
anti_alias: renaming, reversible basis changes, DAG refactoring and fresh aliases cannot discharge debt
terminal: TRUE/FALSE with zero live original semantic bits and zero undischarged debt; SAT reconstructs one original witness
